name: Pattern or demo request
about: Suggest a new pattern to add, or a new demo (real-code or reduced).
title: "[pattern] "
labels: ["library"]

---

## What you'd like to see

A new pattern in the library, or a new demo for an existing pattern.

## Which pattern or family

- Family (Foundations, OOP Basics, Principles, Creational, Structural, Behavioral, Functional, Concurrency, Architecture, Domain & Data, Game Programming, Anti-patterns)
- Pattern name (or "new" if you want a brand-new one)

## Reference material

A link to a book, blog post, or open-source file that defines or demonstrates the pattern.

## Real-code demo?

If the demo should come from real open-source code, paste a permalink to the source file. The project's licence must be MIT, BSD-2/3-Clause, Apache-2.0, PSF-2.0, ISC or MPL-2.0. AGPL, GPL, SSPL, BUSL, Elastic, source-available and "fair-source" licences are not acceptable.

## Why it would help learners

One or two sentences.
